question: In Figure 9E-12, what minimum distance separates the advance motor-vehicle stop line from the intersection stop line across the bicycle box?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The minimum distance is 10 feet. Figure 9E-12 dimensions the bicycle box between the advance stop line (where motor vehicles stop) and the intersection stop line as "10 ft MIN.," reflecting the mandatory minimum length of the bicycle box established in Section 9E.12. Standards (mandatory): - "If used, the distance from the upstream edge of the bicycle box that is nearest to the stop line for motor vehicles to the downstream edge of the bicycle box that is nearest the crosswalk or intersection shall be at least 10 feet. At least one bicycle symbol marking (see Figure 9E-12) shall be used in the bicycle box." - "Where an existing stop line for motor vehicles is relocated upstream to install a new bicycle box, the yellow change and red clearance intervals (see Section 4F.17) shall be recalculated and if necessary, reprogrammed to accommodate the length of the bicycle box." Options (permitted): - "A bicycle box (see Figure 9E-12) may be used to increase the visibility of stopped bicycles on the approach to a signalized intersection during the portion of the signal cycle when a red signal indication is being displayed to motor vehicles in the approach lane(s) that is behind the box." - "Green-colored pavement may be used in a bicycle box." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 9E-12 (Sheet 1 of 2, "A – Bicycle box across one lane") shows a dimension arrow labeled "10 ft MIN." between the intersection stop line and the advance stop line, spanning the green bicycle box. [Image 2] confirms the same "10 ft MIN." callout with the "Intersection stop line" and "Advance stop line" labels on the single-lane bicycle box diagram. [Image 3] shows Sheet 2 of 2 ("B – Bicycle box across multiple lanes") with the same "10 ft MIN." dimension marked between the two stop lines. [Image 4] shows the Section 9E.12 text establishing the 10-foot minimum standard. Citations: - Section 9E.12 Standard §6 (p.1105) - Section 9E.12 Standard §7 (p.1105) - Section 9E.12 Option §1 (p.1105) - Section 9E.12 Option §12 (p.1106) - Figure 9E-12 (p.1106) - Page 1147 - Page 1148 - Page 1146
